summary: A StyledText inside a Block/Inline paragraph keeps its per-run colors, backgrounds and decorations: the paragraph paints every inline piece through ticket 10's per-run painter (rich_paint.go paintStyledVisualLine, extracted from paintStyledDocument) with the paragraph document's runs cut to the piece's byte range (cutPaintRuns), in the pinned two passes (background, then glyphs + decorations). StyledText publishes paint-styled runs; font-only records (the port's Text element) take the paint fields of the paragraph's ambient text style.
pinned_sources: reference/ce-source/crates/gpui/src/text_system/line.rs:421-464 (paint_fragment_decorations_at: background over the row height, underline/strikethrough)
reference/ce-source/crates/gpui/src/elements/text.rs:887-915 (layout publishes InlineContent::Text with the given runs, else text_style.to_run)
reference/ce-source/crates/gpui/src/elements/text.rs:1002-1024 (the paragraph owns a nested text's paint)

files: gpui/inline.go (inlineTextContent.paintStyled; collector paintRuns; paintInlineLayout takes runs + pass; paintChildren paints background then foreground)
gpui/styled_text.go (publishes paintStyled runs; deviation note updated)

deviations: The port's Text element (div.go) publishes font-only runs instead of text_style.to_run; the collector fills their paint fields from the paragraph's (Block/Inline div's) text style, so a plain Text inside a nested Inline span with its own text style paints in the paragraph's style (unchanged from before). Fix belongs in div.go: publish textStyle.ToRun(len) with paintStyled: true.
Decoration offsets use the piece's shaped ascent/descent (the pin reads the whole InlineLayout's ascent/descent and per-fragment Parley offsets); ticket 10's derived fallbacks apply.
Each pass opens its own paragraph layer (the pin also wraps each pass in paint_layer).

richtextspec TestRealInlineStyledTextRuns (real window: sprites per run color within run masks, decorations and background on the run rectangles; fails, never skips)
